scope: Compute bounded slot and average dispatch sizes
tolerance_reason: Only averaged velocity components use f32 tolerance. All copied values, IDs, counters and padding are exact; allocation order is validated as a legal atomic reservation ordering.
preconditions: Bounded complete adjacency, unique entries per body, separate ordinary/split velocity ranges
Assignment starts with reset counters and first slots; other stages receive consistent accepted hub ranges
Finite inputs and sufficient buffers; one writer per split side/velocity slot; group-uniform barriers
invariants: Assignment preserves the total requested slots and admits only a capacity-fitting prefix of some legal atomic reservation order
Rust reduction order and per-workgroup rounds preserved; unused storage and padding unchanged
